# How Much Do Pupils Remember Of Enquiries A Year Later?

## Question

The new curriculum bets that enquiries plus retrieval quizzes make knowledge stick. Do pupils still know the substantive content of a Year 7 enquiry a year later?

## Plan

January 2027, current Year 8: a 15-question quiz on the knowledge organisers of Year 7 enquiries 1, 3 and 5, unannounced, in Quillyard. Priyanka sets it; aggregates only.

## What a useful answer looks like

Above 60% average would suggest the retrieval cycle works. Below 40% would mean the knowledge organisers are too long or quizzes are not spaced enough. The [[retrieval-quiz-bank]] results at Key Stage 4 give a rough benchmark.

## Caveat

No baseline from the old schemes. We are measuring the new curriculum against our hopes, not against the old one.
